partner.title: Spark AI Lab Partner
partner.question: Ask about this experiment
partner.change: What happens if I change an input?
partner.uses: Where is this used in real life?
partner.explainPrompt: Explain the current simulated result step by step. Include the scientific principle, formulas, substitution of current values, input/output relationship, assumptions and a practical application.
partner.privacy: Your question, recent conversation and experiment values are sent to the AI provider. Do not enter personal information. AI explanations may contain errors; verify against the lesson.
partner.snapshotNote: This answer uses the values at the time you asked. Ask again after changing inputs.
partner.offline: AI needs an internet connection. The experiment, cached lessons and supported local narration remain available.
partner.unavailable: AI is unavailable. Start the API server and check its configuration.
partner.cancelled: Request cancelled or timed out. You can retry.
partner.voiceNote: Voice availability depends on your device. Offline speech requires a working on-device voice. Text remains available.
partner.noVoice: No compatible speech voice is available, or playback failed. Read the instructions below or install a voice for this language on your device.
partner.voiceDisabled: Voice guidance is disabled in settings. Text instructions remain available.
partner.noTranslation: Translation is unavailable. Original English instructions are shown; no mismatched-language narration will play.
